topic: India's Special Intensive Revision of the voter rolls (60-second sample)
method: Election Commission press note (primary) cross-checked with Deccan Herald (EC data), The Indian Express (via Wikipedia's citation) and Wikipedia's summary. Allegations attributed; the Commission's answer shown.

claims.claim: By the end of September 2026 the Special Intensive Revision had removed about 13.3 crore (about 130 million) names from India's draft voter rolls, according to Election Commission data.

sources.title: Deccan Herald, 'SIR: 13.3 crore names wiped out of draft voter lists so far, triggering Opposition backlash' (Shemin Joy, 30 Sept 2026; Election Commission data)
sources.quote: 13.3 crore Total deleted names from draft voter lists

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: As of September 2026, the SIR had removed 130 million names from voter rolls

claims.notes: Draft-roll deletions; restorations through claims continue, so final-roll figures may differ.

claims.claim: Of the deleted names, about 71.5% were marked absent, permanently shifted or 'other'; about 2.8 crore were recorded as dead; about 1.01 crore were multiple enrolments.

sources.title: Deccan Herald, 'SIR: 13.3 crore names wiped out of draft voter lists so far, triggering Opposition backlash' (Shemin Joy, 30 Sept 2026; Election Commission data)
sources.quote: Nearly 71.5% ... absent, permanently shifted ... 21% were due to death and 7.5% for multiple enrolments ... 2.8 crore ... 1.01 crore

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: 95 million or 71% under 'absent shifted or others' category, 27 million under deceased category and 10 million as duplicate entries

claims.claim: The SIR re-checks the voter roll: a reference roll is frozen, booth-level officers verify house to house, a draft roll is published, claims and objections are heard (Forms 6, 7 and 8), then the final roll is issued. The last such revision was in 2002-05.

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: freezing reference roll ... house-to-house verification by Booth Level Operators ... publication of draft rolls ... form-6 ... form-7 ... form-8 ... final roll ... since the last such exercise conducted in 2002-05

sources.title: Election Commission of India, Press Note No. ECI/PN/120/2026, 26 Sept 2026
sources.quote: BLOs will visit the homes of such persons for collection of documents

claims.claim: The Indian Express reported on 23 September 2026 that two of the three election commissioners had objected on record to the Chief Election Commissioner's decisions 14 times in 10 months.

sources.title: The Indian Express, '14 times in 10 months, two Election Commissioners objected on record to poll panel steps' (Ritika Chopra, 23 Sept 2026), as cited by Wikipedia
Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: they had formally objected to such decisions 14 times in 10 months

contradictions: The Election Commission said the same day that all key decisions had been taken unanimously, and later described some objections as suggestions (C5).

claims.claim: The Election Commission said all its key decisions were taken unanimously, and on 26 September 2026 issued Press Note ECI/PN/120/2026 with new decisions on the SIR.

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: the Election Commission issued a statement on the same day that all key decisions of the commission had been taken unanimously

sources.title: Election Commission of India, Press Note No. ECI/PN/120/2026, 26 Sept 2026
sources.quote: The meeting of the Commission was held today i.e. 26.09.2026 ... The following decisions were taken

claims.claim: The 26 September press note orders help desks and special camps for people living in night shelters, labourers, the poor and the homeless, and says the Form 6 declaration for the SIR has been upheld by the Supreme Court.

sources.title: Election Commission of India, Press Note No. ECI/PN/120/2026, 26 Sept 2026
sources.quote: special camps for the people living in night shelters, labor, poor people, homeless etc. ... The declaration attached to Form 6 for SIR has been upheld by the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

claims.claim: The Congress Working Committee demanded the immediate restoration of all deleted names; opposition parties have called for the SIR to be annulled.

sources.title: Deccan Herald, 'SIR: 13.3 crore names wiped out of draft voter lists so far, triggering Opposition backlash' (Shemin Joy, 30 Sept 2026; Election Commission data)
sources.quote: The Congress Working Committee has demanded the immediate restoration of all deleted voters

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: opposition parties ... demanding ... annulment of SIR

contradictions: The Election Commission says the revision removes dead, shifted and duplicate entries (C3, C2).

claims.claim: In early October 2026 the Election Commission ordered a drive to enrol voters left out of the rolls.

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: The ECI also announced a 'special drive' for enrollment of voters excluded in SIR

sources.title: The Indian Express, 'After 13 crore names dropped from draft rolls, EC orders left out voter drive' (2 Oct 2026), as cited by Wikipedia

claims.claim: Voters removed as absent or permanently shifted can apply to be added again with Form 6.

sources.title: Deccan Herald, 'SIR: 13.3 crore names wiped out of draft voter lists so far, triggering Opposition backlash' (Shemin Joy, 30 Sept 2026; Election Commission data)
sources.quote: Voters removed for being absent or permanently shifted can apply for re-entry into the final lists by filling out Form-6

sources.title: Wikipedia, '2026 Indian electoral controversy' (read 13 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Form-6 ... was also used for deleted users seeking inclusion in the SIR
